data.name: Aadilah
data.gender_notes: Aadilah is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿādila (عادلة), the feminine active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l. Aadilah therefore means “Just; fair; equitable (feminine)”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿādila 'just, fair'; spelling variant of Aadila.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadilah expresses “Just and Fair”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿādila (عادلة), the feminine active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadilah total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: Is Aadilah the same name as Aadila?
faq.a: Yes - Aadilah and Aadila are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عادلة, meaning 'just, fair'. The final -h is a transliteration choice and does not change the meaning.

faq.q: What does the name Aadilah mean?
Where does the name Aadilah come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadilah?
faq.a: The root of Aadilah is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadilah written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadilah is written عادلة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadilah a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadilah is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aadilah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadilah is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadilah verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just; fair; equitable (feminine)” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿādila 'just, fair'; spelling variant of Aadila..
